projects.skills: SQLGPT is an open-source project designed to help developers, data analysts, and database enthusiasts enhance how to generate GenAI app quickly that can talk with database and return the answers in layman terms. With a focus on clarity, efficiency, and best practices, this repository provides a simple way to develop the genAI skill.

projects.duration: SQLGPT is an advanced SQL query generator powered by natural language processing. Seamlessly transforming plain English queries into complex SQL commands, it simplifies database interactions. With intuitive syntax and intelligent suggestions, it enhances productivity for developers and data analysts alike.
projects.description: Unleashing the Power of SQLGPT: Your GenAI Database Companion! 🚀

Imagine being able to transform plain English queries into intricate SQL commands effortlessly. With SQLGPT, this dream becomes a reality. Its intuitive syntax and intelligent suggestions empower developers to craft complex SQL commands without breaking a sweat. And the best part? It’s all powered by the magic of natural language processing.
